shape.tree:
- dialog "Shape the next mix":
  - banner:
    - heading "Shape the next mix" [level=2]
    - button "Close Shape the next mix"
  - paragraph: Optional shape
  - paragraph: These stay as your defaults for every new mix you build. They don’t change a mix you’ve already got or anything playing now. You can change any transition song by song later.
  - heading "How transitions feel" [level=3]
  - region "Mix controls":
    - text: Transition feel
    - combobox "Transition feel":
      - option "Let each mix choose" [selected]
      - option "Smooth blends"
      - option "Punchy changes"
  - region "Stem transition controls":
    - text: Stem-assisted moves
    - combobox "Stem-assisted moves":
      - option "Never" [selected]
      - option "Sometimes"
      - option "Often"
    - paragraph: Vocal rides and word hand-offs. They’re only used where the pair fits and the render passes its checks.
  - heading "Where the mix goes" [level=3]
  - region "How long":
    - text: How long
    - group "How long, roughly":
      - button "About 30 min · 12 songs" [pressed]
      - button "About 1 hour · 24 songs"
      - button "About 2 hours · 48 songs"
    - paragraph: "The song count is asked for, not promised: how long it really runs depends on where the transitions fall."
  - region "Energy arc controls":
    - text: Energy arc
    - paragraph: Draw the shape you’d like, or set each stop below. Selecta aims for it as closely as your songs allow.
    - button "Use each mix’s arc" [disabled]
    - group "Ready-made energy shapes":
      - button "Build to a peak"
      - button "Peak then settle"
      - button "Even energy"
    - img "Draw energy arc"
    - status: Each mix uses its own shape.
    - text: Start
    - slider "Energy arc start": "62"
    - spinbutton "Energy arc start numeric value": "62"
    - text: Early
    - slider "Energy arc early": "72"
    - spinbutton "Energy arc early numeric value": "72"
    - text: Middle
    - slider "Energy arc middle": "100"
    - spinbutton "Energy arc middle numeric value": "100"
    - text: Late
    - slider "Energy arc late": "85"
    - spinbutton "Energy arc late numeric value": "85"
    - text: Finish
    - slider "Energy arc finish": "68"
    - spinbutton "Energy arc finish numeric value": "68"
    - figure "What your current mix measured":
      - text: What your current mix measured
      - img "Measured relative energy of the current mix, from start to finish"
      - paragraph: "Current mix: relative energy from its quietest to its most energetic song. This uses this mix’s own range, so it is not a score against your requested arc."
  - region "Mix destination":
    - text: Take me to
    - combobox "Take me to"
    - paragraph: If there’s no good way there from the rest of the mix, it finishes as near as it can. Clear it to let each mix decide.
  - contentinfo:
    - button "Done shaping"
